_how: Sources for the Care Plan Builder References tab. Add an entry only after you have opened and checked the source yourself. The server ignores any entry that is missing a field, has a year outside 2021 to 2026, has a non-https url, or is not marked verified: true. A rationale is matched to a source when its topic or text contains one of the keywords (case-insensitive). Every rationale without a match shows 'Not yet verified'.

_example.author: Organization or last name, initials
_example.title: Exact title of the guideline, article or chapter
